judgment.rationale: Both are BASIC 1 Content Standards under STRAND 2: READING (same grain, same resolved rank 0), but in different sub-strands: B1.2.1.2 'Manipulate the sounds of the letters of English' sits under Sub-Strand 1: Pre-Reading Activities, while B1.2.2.1 'Connect sounds to letters and blend letters/syllables in order to read and write' sits under Sub-Strand 2: Phonics. The pre-reading standard targets oral manipulation of English letter sounds; the phonics standard extends this by mapping those sounds to written letters and blending letters/syllables for decoding and encoding. Facility with manipulating sounds substantively supports success in sound-letter correspondence and blending, justifying a same-rank developmental direction from the pre-reading sound work to the phonics application rather than mere shared wording ('letters', 'sounds') or shared code prefix/page proximity. Evidence limitation: both endpoints have truncated source evidence (34 and 50 omitted items) and carry upstream merge/CONT'D duplication context, so the judgment rests on the representative statement text and hierarchy shown.
